note: THE LAYER CELLS: a sequence layer's input as data -- hidden states and values drawn from a seed. How a layer is built from them (RoLA's routing widths, alpha and logit gain; an attention layer's heads) is the arm's.

fields.name: the cell's identity: its input, spelled out; documents and records cite it, so a name is never reused or renamed
fields.tokens: T, the prefill length in tokens
fields.hidden: the hidden width the layer's projections read; 0 means H * dv
fields.dtype: bf16 | fp32, the input dtype (and the dtype an arm builds its layer in)
fields.seed: an arm's parameters from manual_seed(seed); the inputs from a device generator at seed + 500
fields.decode_steps: single-token steps taken after the prefill; 0 is a prefill-only cell
fields.note: what this input is FOR; a layer cell before 2026-09-15 also named a RoLA construction, which the note keeps and rola's layer arms now carry
